arxiv-2210-10597.title: Refined quantum gates for Λ \Lambda -type atom-photon hybrid systems
arxiv-2210-10597.creator: Fang-Fang Du, Yi-Ming Wu, Gang Fan
arxiv-2210-10597.description: Abstract High-efficiency quantum information processing is equivalent to the fewest quantum resources and the simplest operations by means of logic qubit gates. Based on the reflection geometry of a single photon interacting with a three-level Λ \Lambda -typle atom-cavity system, we present some refined protocols for realizing controlled-not (CNOT), Fredkin, and Toffoli gates on hybrid systems.

arxiv-2305-11669.title: Structured factorization for single-cell gene expression data
arxiv-2305-11669.creator: Antonio Canale, Luisa Galtarossa, Davide Risso, Lorenzo Schiavon, Giovanni Toto
arxiv-2305-11669.description: Abstract Single-cell gene expression data are often characterized by large matrices, where the number of cells may be lower than the number of genes of interest. Factorization models have emerged as powerful tools to condense the available information through a sparse decomposition into lower rank matrices.

arxiv-2308-03872.title: Leading all-loop quantum contribution to the effective potential in the inflationary cosmology
arxiv-2308-03872.description: Abstract In this paper, we have constructed quantum effective potentials and used them to study slow-roll inflationary cosmology. We derived the generalised RG equation for the effective potential in the leading logarithmic approximation and applied it to evaluate the potentials of the T 2 T^{2} and T 4 T^{4} -models, which are often used in modern models of slow-roll inflation.

pmc-12688827.title: 3D-printed living implants: advancing cranial reconstruction
pmc-12688827.creator: Muhammad Khizar, Muhammad Zaib, Muhammad Bilal, Hasiba Karimi, Hasibullah Aminpoor
pmc-12688827.description: Severe cranial defects caused by trauma, tumor resection, or congenital anomalies remain challenging to repair. Conventional cranioplasty using autografts or metal/polymer plates carries risks of donor-site morbidity, infection, and suboptimal contour. Patient-specific 3D-printed “living” implant, biodegradable scaffolds seeded with autologous cells, offer precise anatomical fit and active bone regeneration.

pmc-13041074.title: Gender-dependent preferences of medical professionals in treatment choices for irritable bowel syndrome: results from an exploratory study
pmc-13041074.creator: Rosel Sturkenboom, Brigitte A. B. Essers, Ad A. M. Masclee, Daniel Keszthelyi
pmc-13041074.description: BackgroundIrritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS) is a highly prevalent, chronic disorder of the Gut-brain interaction associated with a high healthcare utilization burden. The treatment of IBS remains challenging due to numerous treatment options and heterogeneity in IBS symptoms. Therefore, for effective decision-making, insight into management strategies and treatment preferences of both patients and physicians is important.

pmc-13388920.title: Soft microfingers with flexible tactile sensor using liquid metal for in situ evaluation of cellular spheroid stiffness
pmc-13388920.creator: Satoshi Konishi, Kodai Koyanagi, Tomohiro Nakatsuka, Yuta Kaneko, Kosuke Kusamori, Makiya Nishikawa
pmc-13388920.description: Inflatable soft microfingers integrated with liquid metal strain gauge sensors have been developed for the in situ evaluation of cellular spheroid stiffness.
